name: Blue Garnet
source:
A tiny princess from a far country hired a private detective to find 7 pieces of a magical blue garnet. The pieces are inside 7 girls. To get the garnet out of them, he has to win a card game with them then excite them. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160404053637/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-a.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
